cards.name: Bazaar Trader
cards.oracleText: {T}: Target player gains control of target artifact, creature, or land you control.

cards.name: Bane Alley Broker
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Draw a card, then exile a card from your hand face down.
You may look at cards exiled with this creature.
{U}{B}, {T}: Return a card exiled with this creature to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Binding Negotiation
cards.oracleText: Target opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a nonland card from it. If you do, they discard it. Otherwise, you may put a face-up exiled card they own into their graveyard.

cards.name: Boneyard Parley
cards.oracleText: Exile up to five target creature cards from graveyards. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put all cards from the pile of your choice onto the battlefield under your control and the rest into their owners' graveyards.

cards.name: Corpse Traders
cards.oracleText: {2}{B}, Sacrifice a creature: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a card from it. That player discards that card. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Cutthroat Negotiator
cards.oracleText: Parley — Whenever this creature attacks, each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, you create a tapped Treasure token. Then each player draws a card.

cards.name: Dark Deal
cards.oracleText: Each player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards minus one.

cards.name: High Fae Negotiator
cards.oracleText:
Bargain (You may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token as you cast this spell.)
Flying
When this creature enters, if it was bargained, each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.

cards.name: Hostile Negotiations
cards.oracleText: Exile the top three cards of your library in a face-down pile, then exile the top three cards of your library in another face-down pile. Look at the cards in each pile, then turn a pile of your choice face up. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. You lose 3 life.

cards.name: Kyren Negotiations
cards.oracleText: Tap an untapped creature you control: This enchantment deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.

cards.name: Lawless Broker
cards.oracleText: When this creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

cards.name: Lore Broker
cards.oracleText: {T}: Each player draws a card, then discards a card.

cards.name: Shrewd Negotiation
cards.oracleText: Exchange control of target artifact you control and target artifact or creature you don't control.

cards.name: Warren Soultrader
cards.oracleText: Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

cards.name: Night Dealings
cards.oracleText:
Whenever a source you control deals damage to another player, put that many theft counters on this enchantment.
{2}{B}{B}, Remove X theft counters from this enchantment: Search your library for a nonland card with mana value X, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Streetwise Negotiator
cards.oracleText:
Backup 1 (When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. If that's another creature, it gains the following ability until end of turn.)
This creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.

cards.name: Spawnbroker
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may exchange control of target creature you control and target creature with power less than or equal to that creature's power an opponent controls.

cards.name: Storm Fleet Negotiator
cards.oracleText:
Flying
Parley — Whenever this creature attacks, each player reveals the top card of their library. For each nonland card revealed this way, you create a Map token. Then each player draws a card.
